title: LLM agent 評測基準與工具使用：連結排序
interest: LLM agent 的評測基準（benchmarks）與工具使用能力（tool use）

papers.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
papers.abstract: [Web summary, paraphrased by the fetch tool; not the original abstract] Introduces AgentBench, a benchmark of eight environments testing how well LLMs act as agents in reasoning and decision-making tasks. Top commercial models perform strongly while many open-source models up to 70B lag well behind. Failures are attributed mainly to weak long-term reasoning, decision-making and instruction following; better instruction following and high-quality multi-round alignment data may help, and training on code has mixed effects across agent tasks. Datasets, environments and the evaluation package are publicly released.
papers.reason: 直接命中「LLM agent 評測基準」：提出 8 個環境的 agent benchmark，比較商用與開源模型並分析失敗原因；工具使用僅隱含於環境互動，未專門評測 API 呼叫。

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.abstract: [Web summary, paraphrased by the fetch tool; not the original abstract] Language models solve new tasks from few examples but struggle with arithmetic and factual lookup. Toolformer teaches itself, self-supervised with a handful of demonstrations per API, to decide which tools to call, when, with what arguments, and how to use results. Tools include a calculator, a Q&A system, two search engines, a translation system and a calendar. It improves zero-shot performance on many downstream tasks, often matching much larger models, while keeping language modeling ability.
papers.reason: 高度相關於「工具使用能力」：自監督學習何時、如何呼叫計算機、搜尋、翻譯等 API；但它是訓練方法而非 agent 評測基準，也非多步 agent 設定，故列為 maybe。
